#include<cstdio>
#define ll long long
#define sqrt(x) sqrt(double(x))
#define exp(x,y) (ll)pow(x,y)
#define C(x,y) ((x)/(y))%mod
int fac[1000005],ifac[1000005],mod=1000007;
void init(int n){
    fac[0]=1;ifac[0]=1;
    for(int i=1;i<=n;i++) fac[i]=(ll)fac[i-1]*i%mod;
    ifac[n]=exp(fac[n],mod-2);
    for(int i=n-1;i;i--) ifac[i]=(ll)ifac[i+1]*(i+1)%mod;
}
void dec(int a,int b){
    a=(a+b)%mod;
}
int main(){
#ifdef debug
    freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
#endif
    init(1000000);
    int n,k;scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&k,&mod);
    if(n%2){
        printf("%lld\n",pow(k,n));
        return 0;
    }
    int ans=0,dp[2][1000005];
    dp[0][n]=1;
    for(int i=1;i<=k;i++){
        clr(dp[i&1],0);
        int res=0;
        for(int j=1;j<=n;j++){
            int tmp=dp[i-1&1][j];
            if(!tmp) continue;
            int u=j^(j&-j);
            for(int k=u;k;k=(k-1)&u)
                dec(dp[i&1][k],(ll)tmp*C(j,k));
            dec(res,tmp);
        }
        dec(ans,(ll)res*ifac[k-i]);
    }
    ans=(ll)ans*fac[k]%mod;
    ans=(exp(k,n)-ans+mod)%mod;
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}
